final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy with 49 authoritative zones and 48 delegations. pc50 (`10.16.13.12`) runs the recursive resolver, and all 60 PCs are configured to use it. The zone files include the requested address, glue, and four MX records. Existing topology, addresses, and routes were preserved.

Static checks verified the zone assignments, delegation and glue records, MX targets, client resolver settings, and startup-script syntax. I could not run BIND or test live queries because the environment does not provide access to the Docker daemon or local BIND utilities.
